phases.title: R02 Cheap Screen outcome ledger
phases.objective: Persist one immutable outcome per frozen candidate and a bounded terminal manifest.
exit_criteria: Schema-12 outcome and terminal authority is immutable and atomic.
Cheap Screen and COMPLETE_WAITING_OWNER carry no scientific or Qualified Pool authority.

phases.title: R02 outcome readback integrity
phases.objective: Reconstruct and verify authorization, frozen candidates, outcomes and terminal from one persisted read snapshot.
exit_criteria: Corrupted or partial ledgers fail closed.
Exact final SHA and hosted CI remain external acceptance evidence per D-012.

phases.title: R02 Cheap Screen trainer/executor source
phases.objective: Implement a bounded deterministic Discovery-only executor for the frozen LightGBM, XGBoost and Random Forest candidate universe; verify only with synthetic data.
exit_criteria: R01 exposes a hash-bound Discovery-only training artifact; Locked OOS and Fresh/Forward target outcomes remain unread by the executor.
Candidate adapters, chronological purged split, metric policy and compute-budget enforcement are explicit and bound to frozen authority.
All candidate outcomes are generated internally and committed through the existing atomic ledger; no public outcome-submit API or automatic next block exists.
A durable one-shot execution-attempt marker makes crash/interruption without terminal fail closed; schema-12 databases migrate to schema 13 without losing prior R02 authority.
Synthetic deterministic, negative, backend/frontend, governance, source-only and exact-main Windows CI gates pass.
Real R00/R01/R02 execution, scientific evidence and Owner-PC runtime remain NOT_PROVEN.

phases.title: R02 executor hardening
phases.objective: Harden bounded executor recovery, interruption, resource limits and audit surfaces without creating scientific evidence.
exit_criteria: Restart, timeout and duplicate execution behavior are deterministic and fail closed.
All testing remains synthetic and no real research execution occurs.

phases.title: R03 Full Walk-Forward Analysis source
phases.objective: Implement the separately authorized Full WFA evidence source and the only Qualified Pool admission authority.
exit_criteria: WFA folds, purge/embargo, metrics and persistence are explicit and tested with synthetic data.
R03 source does not consume Locked OOS or Fresh/Forward outcomes.

phases.title: R04 Owner selection and CPCV
phases.objective: Implement explicit Owner candidate selection and CPCV evidence under frozen seed and partition authority.
exit_criteria: Owner-only selection and deterministic CPCV lineage are enforced.
No CPCV result is represented as Owner acceptance without Owner action.

phases.title: R05 tournament source
phases.objective: Implement bounded tournament comparisons over only eligible upstream candidates.
exit_criteria: Tournament lineage, deterministic ranking and hard-failure preservation are tested synthetically.
No tournament outcome directly mutates Champion authority.

phases.title: R06 Monte Carlo source
phases.objective: Implement deterministic Monte Carlo robustness evidence with explicit resampling authority.
exit_criteria: Resampling, seeds, metrics and evidence retention are explicit and tested synthetically.
Monte Carlo remains evidence, not Owner promotion.

phases.title: R07 Locked OOS source
phases.objective: Implement single-purpose Locked OOS access under explicit Owner-gated, non-adaptive authority.
exit_criteria: Protected outcomes cannot flow into training or adaptive feedback.
Repeat access, stale authority and cross-epoch access fail closed.

phases.title: R08 Fresh/Forward source
phases.objective: Implement distinct Fresh/Forward validation authority without adaptive leakage.
exit_criteria: Fresh/Forward evidence is chronologically and lineage-bound.
Forward outcomes cannot tune candidates or rewrite prior authority.

phases.title: R09 final fit source
phases.objective: Implement final fit only after explicit upstream scientific and Owner gates.
exit_criteria: Final-fit data scope, candidate identity and runtime authority are explicit.
No real training or scientific result is claimed by source/CI tests.

phases.title: R09 ONNX source
phases.objective: Implement gated ONNX export and parity verification only after final-fit authority.
exit_criteria: Export policy, model compatibility and deterministic parity tests are explicit.
No production ONNX artifact is created by synthetic CI.

phases.title: R10 Research Model Package
phases.objective: Implement immutable Research model package construction and verification.
exit_criteria: Package contents bind to exact scientific lineage and accepted artifact hashes.
Synthetic packaging tests do not create a real Research package.

phases.title: R10 Strategy Challenger creation
phases.objective: Implement Owner-gated conversion from a fully accepted Research package to a Strategy Challenger.
exit_criteria: Research evidence cannot bypass existing Strategy Challenger and Champion authorities.
No real Challenger or Champion mutation occurs in source/CI validation.
